question: Does source-only all-11 Gagné empirical decay B improve later conditional machine gauge-pressure prediction over N on one authenticated existing PLAY-002 cohort? W is secondary.

essential_rules: Achieved machine pressure with declared gauge-bar basis; command separate; no puck-face claim.
Native showerhead volume flow with justified mL/s conversion; no scale-flow, command-flow or density substitution.
Actual basket-temperature semantics and units distinct from mix, setpoint and other machine sensors.
Authenticated native elapsed-time zero and compatible post-bloom protocol.
Native 42<=t<47 anchor and 47<=t<=75 evaluation; no gap stretching, resampling or padded scoring.
Physical-shot identity/version crosswalk, duplicate-upload handling and source-target disjointness including Gagné copies.
Existing research permission; no raw redistribution.
qualification.selection: Apply semantic/protocol/support rules without suffix pressure or historical/new errors. Choose largest authenticated physical-shot count; stable private cohort ID breaks ties; retain all qualifying physical shots. No switch after errors.
qualification.stop: All existing candidate memberships lack required source authority. No cohort selected; later support, physical deduplication and disjointness cannot be authenticated. This is not corpus exhaustion.
qualification.sampling_rule_status: NOT_REACHED: no target time/Q/T/P arrays opened; no target numerical support acceptance rule or prediction freeze fabricated.
qualification.calibration: Unknown calibration/location/latency systematics remain separate from unresolved essential quantity semantics; no zero-uncertainty assignment.

bands.sensitivity: All nine independent 0.75/1/1.25 multipliers of 10% and 25% boundaries; no prediction changes.

One auxiliary h=1 B fit on Gagné, unchanged transfer; N remains g=1, W remains h(T). Cannot replace primary.
